liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Wharf Rat** (4 reviews): Listener recalls this specific performance as being especially fine; Centerpiece featuring majestic harmonies and two pummeling, soaring end jams [8][13][14][16]
- **Jack Straw** (3 reviews): Described as a thundering performance of this first set song; Noted as a super intense performance during the show [9][13][17]
- **Peggy-O** (1 review): Characterized as a heart-wrenching rendition within the first set [9]
- **Deal** (1 review): The chorus was repeated over forty times during the performance [8]
- **Sugar Magnolia** (1 review): Balls-out rock and roll, representing the band at their peak of fun [18]

## The recordings

- **gd1978-04-22.133786.sbd.miller.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 19 songs; 175 min; rated 5/5 by 6 [1]
- **gd1978-04-22.169184.sony.54p.wagner.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 19 songs; 184 min [2]
- **gd1978-04-22.sonyECM250.walker-scotton.miller.92808.flac16**: source not stated; 19 songs; 164 min; rated 4.91/5 by 11 [5]. Said about its sound: Sound is well-balanced and full, brought back to life with digital magic; Clear and crisp with well-balanced instruments and minimal crowd noise; Wonderful sounding audience tape, difficult to capture in that room [7][9][14]
- **gd1978-04-22.169183.sony.54p.wagner.miller.clugston.flac1648**: audience recording; 19 songs; 184 min [3]

## Around the show

- Rumored to hold a record for the chorus repetition count [15]
- Background chanting occurs as the band enjoys the post-drums segment [16]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1978-04-22.133786.sbd.miller.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Set 1: SBD -> Master Cassette -> Dat (44.1k)Set 2: SBD -> Master Reel -> Dat (44.1k) [1]. Also: Joe B. Jones helped pitch correct the patch source [1]
- **gd1978-04-22.169184.sony.54p.wagner.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Bob Wagner; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Bob Wagner's Master FOB (10th row) Audience Cassettes; Sony 54p (x3) mics > Nakamichi 550 [2]. Also: Bob Wagner provided master cassettes for the Roses section; Sony ECM250 source patches Eyes Of the World and Sugar Magnolia [2]
- **gd1978-04-22.sonyECM250.walker-scotton.miller.92808.flac16**: taped by Joani Walker; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Sony ECM-250 -> Cassette Master (Sony TC-158/Maxell UDXL-II90) [5]. Also: Charlie Miller transferred and mastered the old audience recording; Walker, Scotton, and Miller collections are considered top archive recordings; Paul Scotton and Joani Walker provided the original tapes [5][7][12]
- **gd1978-04-22.169183.sony.54p.wagner.miller.clugston.flac1648**: taped by Bob Wagner; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Bob Wagner's Master FOB (10th row) Audience Cassettes; Sony 54p (x3) mics > Nakamichi 550 [3]
